target_customer: Biotech and industrial teams that engineer proteins
problem: Discovering and optimizing useful proteins takes long design, build and test cycles.
business_model: Software and tools for protein design (later described as an MLOps platform)

founders.name: Tyler Shimko
founders.background_notes: Named as founder and CEO in Crunchbase snippets. A Stanford genetics PhD is claimed in search snippets but no opened source states it, so education is null. The YC page lists no founder names.

technical_complexity.rationale: Combining predictive protein models with sequence optimization to design gene libraries was research adjacent work for a one person team in 2020.

defensibility.rationale: The claimed edge was an in-house sequence optimization algorithm, with no data or customer lock-in described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying it. Well funded AI protein design firms such as Cradle and Profluent launched in 2022 and 2023, after the batch.

market_need_then: The YC description cites slow design-build-test loops in protein optimization. No dated demand or spend evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: trident.bio now redirects to a GoDaddy for sale page.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community material was found and the domain is now listed for sale.

outcome_analysis: Trident Bioscience was a one person YC Summer 2020 company with a roughly 130K seed from YC and no later funding found. YC lists it inactive and its trident.bio domain is for sale, but no post-mortem or shutdown notice exists, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty.
notes: Seed amount rests on databases only: CB Insights 130K, Village 125K. The domain trident.bio redirected to a GoDaddy for sale page when fetched, which is consistent with a dead site. Search snippets mention a product called Mariner, an MLOps platform for life sciences; its date and whether it was a pivot are unsourced so no pivot is recorded. Competitor search found only later entrants (Cradle 2022, Profluent), so the list is empty.
